annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because the title and narration frame it as a hands-on test of Taco Bell's food-ordering app. The order-confirmation, pickup choices, debit-card discussion, and payment screen are presented as ordinary steps in buying food. Payment uncertainty and the closure notice provide a testing-and-problem-reporting context, without establishing that payment was captured or the order fulfilled.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an operational demonstration and test of a food-ordering technology tool, including trying the app, selecting a location, discussing payment options, and viewing order confirmation and pickup choices.
